gloss: personal profile for an arranged-marriage meeting

definitions.gloss: personal profile for arranged-marriage meeting; matchmaking résumé
definitions.explanation: A written profile prepared for お{見合|みあい} (matchmaking meetings), traditionally listing the candidate's family background, education, work, hobbies, and other particulars. Exchanged in advance through the matchmaker or marriage agency.

examples.japanese: {釣書|つりがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{釣書|つりがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my mother prepare my matchmaking profile.
Before the matchmaking meeting, I looked through the other person's profile.

notes:
Also read つりしょ. Traditionally written by hand on Japanese paper and accompanied by a family-tree document ({家族書|かぞくしょ}). In modern arranged matches handled by marriage agencies, a simpler printed profile has replaced the formal handwritten version.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釣書|つりがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a marriage profile
- {釣書|つりがき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exchange profiles
- {釣書|つりがき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}を{通|とお}す→目を通す：06904_mewotoosu⟧: to look through a profile

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧: résumé — for employment, not marriage
- ⟦プロフィール→プロフィール：06474_purofiiru⟧: profile — modern, used by marriage agencies and apps
- {身上書|しんじょうしょ}: personal-background document — older formal term for the same kind of profile
